Karakteristikat e Prones:
– Apartament 2+1
– Kompleksi Ana
– Pallat i ri, Kati i 4
– Siperfaqja e Bruto 98.7m²
– Cmimi 223.000 Euro
Shitet apartament 2+1+2WC ne Kompleksin Ana, nje zgjedhje ideale per banim komod ose investim te sigurt. Apartamenti ofrohet i mobiluar me mobilim bashkekohor dhe stil modern, duke krijuar nje ambient te ngrohte dhe funksional. Organizohet ne nje sallon te bollshem me kuzhine te integruar, dy dhoma gjumi te ndricuara natyralisht, dy tualete dhe ballkon. Hapesirat jane te shfrytezueshme ne maksimum dhe ofrojne rehati ne cdo detaj. Ndodhet ne nje zone te preferuar me akses te shpejte ne sherbime, shkolla dhe transport. Apartament gati per banim, perfekt per familje ose per investim afatgjate. Apartamenti ka orientim JUG – LINDJE.
Aktualisht eshte i pershtatur ne tipologjine 1+1 por mund te kthehet lehtesisht ne planimetrine fillestare 2+1.
Apartamenti dposnon gjithashtu nje post parkimi ne vlere 25000 euro dhe nje garazhd te mbyllur me cmim 35000 euro.
Kompleksi ANA ndodhet ne nje zone e cila i ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme, si dyqane, market, farmaci, shkolla kopshte etj.
Per me shume informacione ose per nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjencise imobiliare!
title_en: Apartment for sale 2+1+2WC+Blk, Complex Ana, 223.000 Euro
description_en: Property Features: - 2+1 Apartment - Ana Complex - New Building, 4th Floor - Gross Area 98.7m² - Price 223,000 Euro 2+1+2WC apartment for sale in Ana Complex, an ideal choice for comfortable living or safe investment. The apartment is offered furnished with contemporary furniture and modern style, creating a warm and functional environment. It is organized in a spacious living room with an integrated kitchen, two naturally lit bedrooms, two toilets and a balcony. The spaces are usable to the maximum and offer comfort in every detail. It is located in a preferred area with quick access to services, schools and transport. Ready-to-move-in apartment, perfect for a family or long-term investment. The apartment has SOUTH-EAST orientation. It is currently adapted to the 1+1 typology but can easily be returned to the original 2+1 floor plan. The apartment also has a parking space worth 25,000 euros and a closed garage worth 35,000 euros. The ANA complex is located in an area that offers all the necessary facilities, such as shops, markets, pharmacies, kindergartens, etc. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency!
